mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may cause hypokalemia and electrolyte disturbances that could theoretically impair immune function, while vedolizumab is an immunosuppressive agent requiring careful monitoring of overall immune status.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly in patients receiving both agents; consider alternative antihypertensive if hypokalemia develops, as it may compromise the efficacy or safety of vedolizumab therapy.
